messages.content: Propose an improvement: I report that meal lookup asks too many repeated questions. A good solution would reuse details I already gave, reducing effort; the risk is reusing the wrong meal. Measure repeated clarification questions per completed meal. Save this as a proposal for review, not an implemented feature.

review: Record reported evidence honestly, describe risks and a success metric, require review, and never claim implementation.
